headline: OpenAI says it will add a College Planner to ChatGPT for Teens to help US high-school students track applications, deadlines and financial aid, but has given no release date.
score_reason: Pool 5 kept: affects many students, but the planner is not yet released and the usage figures are OpenAI's and do not show learning benefits.
importance_line: US teens in grades 10 to 12 may get an AI organiser for college applications, but it has no release date and OpenAI's usage numbers show use, not better results.
summary: EdTech Innovation Hub reports that OpenAI plans a College Planner for ChatGPT for Teens that would gather application requirements, deadlines and financial-aid tasks into one plan for US students in grades 10 to 12, alongside new flashcard, quiz and note-photo study features. OpenAI gives no release date, and as the article points out, its figures such as nearly 1.2 million teens trying Learning Visualizations in a week show use of the tools, not better learning.
notes: default_v1 was MOD; main subject is education for teens, so SOC.
